paragraphs: R. Yaakov bar Ḥisda, chapter HaMafkid (I did not find mention of him); if so, Rav Ḥisda had five sons. I did not understand his astonishment in saying, 'If so, he had five sons,' for his intention is that R. Yaakov is additional to the four known sons of Rav Ḥisda. See Rav Ḥisda, and you will find that he had seven sons. The truth is that I did not find mention of R. Yaakov bar Ḥisda. Even if you search for him with lamps and find a R. Yaakov bar Ḥisda, he is not Rav Ḥisda's son. You will also find Avdimi bar Ḥisda, Avin bar Ḥisda, and Shemuel bar Ḥisda.
